messages:
maya: Heads up — ACME onboarding showing two urgent signals: initial priming causing token-cost spikes and live responses slower than expected. Drafting a compact customer-facing 'engage guide' with concrete caching/batching/streaming knobs + renewal health signals. Quick eyes?
sam: On it. Quick checklist from eng: prefill common prompts, lower TTL for session caches, reduce batch max_size for low-traffic tenants, enable streaming for UI flows. Also include fallback model option. :thumbsup:
maya: Current telemetry (24h window): active_sessions=3, avg_response_time=420ms, token_cost/day=+$320 (baseline $40). Renewal-risk flags: low usage + cost spike + NPS pending.
rafa: Ops notes: confirm autoscale headroom and KV warm-pool counts before we enable aggressive prefill. If no dedicated capacity, route priming traffic to a smaller model variant to keep latency/cost predictable. Add jitter to prefill schedule to avoid sync spikes.
maya: Draft config snippet I'm planning to share (one-page, just actionable fields):
```yaml
prefill:
  enabled: true
  batch_size: 4            # small batches for low-activity tenants
  jitter_ms: 300-1200      # spread background priming
  ttl_seconds: 600         # 10m session cache
cache:
  scope: session
  max_entries: 150
  eviction_policy: lru
routing:
  fallback_model: "redwood-small-v1"
telemetry:
  alert_if:
    - "active_sessions < 5 and avg_latency_ms > 300"
    - "token_cost_change_pct > 200"
```
maya: Also a short customer email checklist I'll attach: 1) enable prefill toggle, 2) set TTL to 10m, 3) reduce batch size to 4 during low-traffic priming, 4) enable streaming on the UI route, 5) whitelist critical prompts to avoid model swaps.
olivia: Add a line on measuring quality impact: run a 50-sample eval of the critical prompt set before/after switching to the smaller model and include rollback steps. Provide a per-route override recipe so high-value paths always hit full model.
maya: Draft of the short email to ACME (will tighten):
"Hi Jorge — we saw some cost/latency signs during your initial activation. Can you enable the prefill flag in the tenant console? We recommend TTL=10m, batch_size=4, and streaming for the UI. We'll run a short eval during our call and monitor quality. Can we do a 30min walkthrough Tues 11am PT? Link to quick feedback form: https://forms.redwood.example/acme-onboard-feedback"
jorge: Thanks — can you confirm risk to accuracy if we switch priming to the smaller model? Also Tue 11am PT works for us.
sam: Accuracy note: slight degradation expected on rare entity/long-context prompts. Mitigation: per-route override (see snippet) to pin select endpoints to full model; use smaller model only for background priming.
rafa: I'll pre-stage a tiny warm-pool and wire KV watch to avoid cold misses. I'll also add a temporary throttle on background priming so DB calls and downstream hooks don't spike.
olivia: I'll run the Tue session and bring a tiny eval script + rollback recipe. I'll collect customer feedback into the form (link above) and capture the top-3 issues.
maya: Final action items before email: @olivia run Tue 11 PT walkthrough; @rafa prepare warm-pool and throttles; @sam create per-route override snippet and a short eval script; @jorge enable prefill flag in console and share any critical prompt examples.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: prefill-config v2 -> staging (deploy_id: dpl-8792). ETA ~8m.
maya: Great — I'll fold in the edits and send the one-pager + email. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
